claims: The Artemis II Orion capsule splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II splashdown location was approximately 40-70 miles off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II splashdown occurred on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II splashdown occurred at approximately 8:07 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II splashdown occurred at 5:07 p.m. PDT.
Recovery teams aboard the USS John P. Murtha were stationed in the area to recover the four astronauts.
The recovery vessel for the Artemis II splashdown was the USS John P. Murtha.
The Artemis II mission duration was 10 days.
The Artemis II astronaut crew consisted of Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
Navy divers and specialists worked to secure the capsule.
The astronauts were transferred to a helicopter for transport to the USS John P. Murtha.
The Artemis II splashdown was broadcast live.
